items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: No, I only know him. I know the bass player, but I can't call his name. He's dead too. And Tab Lyon Kato was playing with him too.

ctx.x: Who was in that band with him? Do you remember the guy?

No, I only know him. I know the bass player, but I can't call his name. He's dead too. And Tab Lyon Kato was playing with him too. Who? Little Kato. Not Tab. Tab was a piano player. Tab played bass violin too. You know him?
No, Tab? Yeah. No, I didn't know him.

items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, there's big Kato and little Kato. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, this was a big one. He's a big fella.

ctx.x: Well, that's his brother who played the piano. Oh. And he had a nephew play piano. And he still have a nephew up in California playing piano.
Well, there's big Kato and little Kato.
Yeah, this was a big one. He's a big fella.
